0022600111.text: The Suns host the Warriors in their second game of the 2026-27 season, while Golden State has yet to play this season. Phoenix is without Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), and Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams met in 2025-26, when the Suns lost 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 101-97 Suns loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
